title: Research: exhaust rational rank cuts before bit scalar-word search
body:
## Summary

The four-role example in Discussion #2200 had only a handwritten projection rejection before its planned scalar search. Add a reusable exact screen for every rational linear projection/rank cut of a bounded paid-frame multiset.

```text
paid-frame subset spans, at most 2^n
  compute the exact minimum cut margin
  emit an integer separating functional when the margin is negative
```

The [proof and checker](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9302e18fb9c75cd661adc1c6334a1d96d04b434e/research/bit-rational-rank-cut-screen/README.md) show why paid spans cover all rational functionals. The CLI accepts address dimension at most four and at most twelve paid frames/target roles. This is a recorded changed scope from `bit-new-register-model`, priority revision 5. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2200#discussioncomment-18967453).

## Evidence

- **Before:** all nine coordinate cuts pass the discarded eight-frame example; its combined projection obstruction was checked by hand.
  **After:** all 16 paid spans are checked and an exact witness gives two surviving paid factors against three target roles, excluding every scalar choice/order and restored dirty workspace in the stated model.
- All 525 independent integer-functional oracle cases agree. The nine-call direct word passes, its missing-call mutation rejects, and the capacity control reaches all 4,096 spans. Seventeen invalid-input controls and actual CLI/receipt mutations pass.
- Registered replay passed on CPython 3.12.15; optimized standalone replay and CLI controls passed on CPython 3.14.8, macOS arm64. Source pins, warning-as-error compilation, Ruff checks and committed-byte preflight pass.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-rational-rank-cut-screen
```

The projection inequality belongs to Ali Romman's PR #468 and its retained eumemic/huxint lineage. The example and original rejecting functional belong to @1337isnot1337 in Discussion #2200. The contribution is the complete finite screen and rerunnable evidence. Substantial AI assistance was used for derivation, implementation, internal checks and writing; no independent human review is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

Only the new opt-in package is added. Passing establishes necessary cuts only; determinant equality, full formal identities, native realization, complete supplier costs and the selected cold replay are outside scope. No supplier admission, selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed. Hosted CI is separate from the local evidence above.
